about: BHA-CI-FAST-001. The integration tests run in 4 CI jobs. Shards 1-3 run exactly the classes named here; shard 4 runs every class that is not named, so a new test class is never skipped (it lands in shard 4). Measured on the CI run of the first sharded head (all tests passing, GitHub-hosted runner, PostgreSQL 18.3): shards 1-3 about 368, 356, 367 s of test time, shard 4 about 371 s. When shard 4 grows past the others, move a class from it into a named list. Only the balance depends on this file, never the coverage: the Backend gate compares what ran with the unfiltered list of tests.
